pages.text: Coruscant Panels are valuable treasures hidden in dungeons $(thing)everywhere except the Nether$(). To find them, you can use a $(item)Tainted Gem$(). Place a ring of 8 tainted dust on the ground, then stand in the middle while holding a single diamond to attune it to the nearest structure containing Coruscant Panels. The gem will flash brightly when you face in the proper direction.

pages.title: Tainted Gem
pages.text: You can repeat this to reattune the gem whenever you want.$(br2)Additionally, if you place $(thing)Sandstone, Snow, Mossy Cobblestone, Prismarine, or Quartz$() in the center of the ring to attune the gem, it will instead lead you to a specific structure containing $(item)Echo Shards$().
